claims: The Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission launched from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Complex 39B.
The launch window for the Artemis II mission initially opened at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission launched from Pad 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket lifted off to begin the Artemis II mission.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day crewed mission around the Moon.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket successfully delivered the Orion capsule.
The Orion capsule carried Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
